assertions.evidence: In lead_routing.ts, classifyLead checks headcount/regions first: `if (lead.headcount > 1000 || new Set(lead.regions).size >= 3) { return Promise.resolve('enterprise'); }` and only otherwise calls `decideCompanyWideRollout(lead.lookingFor)`.
makeJevRolloutChecker posts to `https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions` with `model: "typesafe/jev-1.13"` (a pinned version) in the request body.
The request `state` is `{ looking_for: lookingFor }`, containing only the free-text; no headcount or region fields are sent.
